title: Let reverence replace the room fear built
summary: Reverent service turns fear from a ruler into a doorway. The heart becomes like the One it serves when awe steadies it from within.
takeaway: Let reverence train fear into fearless service.
lifeApplication: When fear starts arranging the room, pause before obeying it. Serve one true thing in front of you until reverence, not alarm, sets the tone.

source.shortMeaning: Fear is transformed when the heart lives in reverent service to the True Guru.
source.lifeApplication: When fear starts arranging the room, return the body to one reverent act of service.

evidence.coreClaim: Fear is transformed when the heart lives in reverent service to the True Guru.
evidence.turn: Reverence does not leave fear in charge; it draws the heart toward the Fearless One it serves.
evidence.practicalImplication: When fear starts arranging the room, pause before obeying it. Serve one true thing in front of you until reverence, not alarm, sets the tone.
